conditions.http_transport: in-process FastAPI TestClient (not network or browser)
conditions.redis: real isolated Redis 7; no persisted data
conditions.market_data: fixture closes; no artificial network delay; no live or paid provider calls
conditions.workload: 3 rounds, each with 100 uncached + 100 cached requests; 5 symbols repeated 20 times
conditions.cache_policy: actual wall-clock policy, including cold misses in cached runs
conditions.limitations: Designed repetition is not production demand. Latency excludes upstream network and browser polling.
